publishCurrentDoc: Publish current document to Cloudflare Pages
buildWarnings: Build finished with warnings, see the console
settingAccountIdDesc: Found in the right sidebar of the Cloudflare dashboard.
settingProjectNameDesc: An existing Pages project. It must have been created as a Direct Upload project.
settingApiTokenDesc: Needs Account → Cloudflare Pages → Edit. The token is stored with the plugin data in this workspace; do not share that file.
settingBranchDesc: Leave empty or use the production branch (usually main). Any other value creates a preview deployment.
settingAddTitle: Add the document title on top of the page
settingAddTitleDesc: When disabled only the document body is published.
settingContentWidthDesc: Any CSS length, for example 800px or 60rem.
settingTestConnectionDesc: Reads the Pages project with the credentials above. No deployment is created.
